items.prompt:
A wave is a disturbance that carries:
A) Matter only
B) Energy from place to place
C) Nothing
D) Only color
items.answer: B) Energy from place to place

steps: Waves carry energy from one place to another.

items.prompt:
The amplitude of a wave is its:
A) Length
B) Height from rest
C) Speed
D) Color

steps: Amplitude is how far the wave moves from rest.

items.prompt:
The distance from one crest to the next crest is the:
A) Amplitude
B) Wavelength
C) Frequency
D) Height

A larger amplitude means a wave carries:
A) Less energy
B) More energy
C) No energy
D) Only sound

steps: Amplitude is related to energy; larger amplitude means more energy.

items.prompt:
Two waves have the same wavelength; Wave A has a larger amplitude. Wave A carries:
A) Less energy
B) More energy
C) The same energy
D) No energy

Frequency measures:
A) The height of a wave
B) How many waves pass a point each second
C) The color of a wave
D) The wave's rest position
items.answer: B) How many waves pass a point each second

items.prompt:
A wave carries a lot of energy and its wavelength is unchanged. Its amplitude must be:
A) Small
B) Large
C) Zero
D) Negative

steps: More energy at the same wavelength means a larger amplitude.

items.prompt:
Which statement about waves is correct?
A) Waves mainly move matter far along with them
B) Waves carry energy, and amplitude is related to that energy
C) Amplitude has nothing to do with energy
D) Waves carry no energy
items.answer: B) Waves carry energy, and amplitude is related to that energy

steps: Waves transfer energy, and amplitude relates to the energy carried.
